Definition: to gleam, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; by transference to sound clear (of various animal or human expressions)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to neigh, cry shrilly; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to neigh (of men as stallions-fig.); 1a2) (Piel) to cry shrilly (in distress); 2) (Hiphil) to make shining
